title: Smoked Lamb Bao with Chinese Caramel Sauce
description: A fusion of Asian and Mediterranean flavors, this dish combines tender smoked lamb with the sweetness of Chinese caramel sauce, served in a crispy bao bun.

ingredients.name: bao buns
ingredients.notes: available in most Asian grocery stores

instructions: Wrap the bao buns in foil and bake for 5 minutes.
In a small saucepan, combine sugar, soy sauce, and rice vinegar.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove the bao buns from the oven and toast them with a kitchen torch or under the broiler for 1-2 minutes.
Slice the smoked lamb into thin strips and brush with sesame oil.
Assemble the bao by spooning the caramel sauce onto the bottom bun, then topping with sliced lamb and finishing with the top bun.
